International Energy Agency (2026). Global Methane Tracker 2026: methane abatement data (oil and gas, region World), average gas prices, CH4 emissions by production source (2025), and methane emissions comparison (World). Data files downloaded from iea.org (Methane Tracker / Methane Abatement Model data product) on 2026-10-06. Paris: IEA.

Data files, not a report. Held as iea/iea_2026_methane-tracker-abatement-data.csv (4,823 rows: region, country, production source, segment, type, abatement measure, savings kt CH4, cost USD/MBtu), -gas-prices-data.csv (26 regions, USD/MBtu), -emissions-by-source-data.csv (3,220 rows, 2025, kt CH4 by country, production source and reason), -emissions-comparison-data.csv (4 rows, World totals by sector: energy 147,733 kt, agriculture 146,754, waste 61,152, other 7,785). Loaded: Canada and United States rows only (164): abatement-cost per measure (USD per MBtu of gas saved, as printed, may be negative) with one description row per example; savings (kt CH4/yr) for each row in _measures. Process = country, segment, production source. Other-values: Canada and US CH4 emissions by production source and reason (2025, non-zero only) and the gas price (2.275 USD/MBtu for both). Not loaded: other countries; the World comparison file (no Canada/US data). Reference column cites the file row (locator = file name plus row key; no pages). Traps: (1) price year, discount rate, lifetime and heating-value basis of MBtu not stated in the files. (2) Cost is per MBtu of gas saved, not per t CH4; convert with a gas CH4-content and heating-value factor, which the files do not give. (3) Several country-source-measure keys have two rows (Improve flaring, Vapour recovery units for oil sources) with different costs and savings; kept as separate processes (" - second ... entry"). (4) Measure definitions are not in the files ("Replace with electric motor" is assumed to be a pneumatic-device replacement per IEA model documentation, not verified here; "Other" undefined). (5) Savings are national potentials, not per-unit values. UPDATE 2026-10-07 (batch C1): price year relabelled 2026_USD -> 2025_USD in all 164 main abatement-cost rows, 164 _measures rows and the gas-price other-value. Evidence: no dollar year is printed in the files, the GMT 2026 Documentation (iea/iea_2026_global-methane-tracker-documentation.pdf), the GMT 2026 report or the IEA open-source cost model (iea_2026_005); the Documentation states gas well-head prices from average 2025 prices (p.24), 2025 electricity and coal prices (p.29), discount rate 8%, costs from US information adjusted with ILO labour, Bloomberg (2024) and WTO data (p.21); the report's cost curve is titled 2025 'based on average energy prices in 2025'. Many model base_capital values are 1.37 x round EPA Natural Gas STAR figures (a single escalation of older US costs to a recent year). Treat 2025_USD as an inferred, not printed, price year.
